query: SELECT s.started_at,s.session_id,jsonb_build_object('session_id',s.session_id,'client_name',s.client_name,'caller_label',coalesce(c.label,'Unknown'),'started_at',s.started_at,'ended_at',s.ended_at,'calls',s.calls,'errors',s.errors,'transport',s.transport) AS session FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN callers c ON c.id=s.caller_id WHERE s.project_id=$1 AND (s.started_at,s.session_id)<($2,$3) AND ($4::bigint IS NULL OR s.caller_id=$4) AND ($5::text IS NULL OR s.client_name=$5) ORDER BY s.started_at DESC,s.session_id DESC LIMIT 51
